title: Email Marketing List Cleanup & Setup
systemName: Your email deliverability recovery and cart integration

facts: Post: email ops not actively managed for about a year; blocks by some mailbox providers; IP and domain reputation concerns.

Post asks: audit, list cleanup (invalid, bounces, complaints, inactives, suppression), SPF/DKIM/DMARC, platform recommendation and migration (Omnisend, Klaviyo, SendGrid named), custom cart integration via APIs/webhooks, abandoned-cart recovery, automations, 90-day campaign calendar, monitoring.
Post asks applicants to reference Project Eagle. Client name not verified; account label uses the post's project name.
n8n is not named in the post; it is shown as the webhook and sync layer between their custom cart, the current system and the chosen platform.

scenes.title: Clean every list before anything gets sent.
scenes.caption: Bounces and complaints go to suppression, inactive contacts wait for a win-back, and only safe addresses move to the new platform.
scenes.beat: First, the list cleanup. n8n pulls each list from your current system and tags hard bounces, spam complaints, invalid addresses and contacts who haven't engaged in a year. Imogen is a recent buyer, so she moves to the new platform. Anyone flagged goes to suppression or a slow win-back instead, so they stop hurting your reputation.
details: One suppression list covers every list and every platform

scenes.title: See what is hurting your sender reputation.
scenes.caption: Each authentication and blocklist finding comes with its fix and the order to do it in.
scenes.beat: Next is the deliverability audit for your sending domain. In this sample, SPF is over its lookup limit, DKIM isn't signing for the current sender, DMARC only monitors with no reports going anywhere, and the sending IP is on one public blocklist. Each finding has its fix and who handles it, me or your developers.

scenes.title: Recover abandoned carts from your own checkout.
scenes.caption: Your cart sends a webhook, n8n checks the shopper, and the new email platform starts the recovery email.
scenes.beat: Then the abandoned-cart flow. When Imogen leaves two items in your cart, your checkout sends a webhook to n8n. It maps the cart items and checks that she isn't suppressed and hasn't already paid. Then it sends the cart event to the email platform, which starts the recovery email.
details: Works with your custom cart, not a plugin
The webhook payload and event names are documented for your developers.
